platform.renderer_for_captures: Godot 4.7.1 Forward+ (reference PC) and Compatibility (headless review path)

verified: working lamps under the four light anchors: shadowed warm low beams (30 energy, 120 m, 38 degrees, dipped 2.2 degrees) with 3 m spills under the head anchors, red glows under the tail anchors
SkyLighting publishes CurrentPreset and PresetChanged; the rig lights the lamps for Night and Dawn and douses them for Day and Overcast from whatever preset is current when it enters the tree
vehicle-visual stages assert lamps lit at night and doused by day; the walk-around runs its second half at night
tail bar and projector lens emission scaled to 12 percent when doused; beam shadows off under the graybox-assets flag so the software-rendered semantic suite keeps its settle windows
reference performance capture at 1440p on the RTX 3080 Ti: night with lamps 3.43 ms mean frame against 2.95 ms by day without them
excluded_claims: frame-time claims for tiers other than Balanced on the reference PC

metrics.vehicle_visual_marker: CANNONBALL_VEHICLE_VISUAL_OK semantic_nodes=37 lods=3 damage_zones=5 wheelbase_m=2.84 track_m=1.64 graybox_equivalent=True

reference_performance.note: bounds the beams plus the night preset together at under 0.5 ms mean on the reference PC; machine was not idle

failure_logs: the first beam (18 energy, 90 m, dipped 3.5 degrees) reached about twenty metres from the eye point; a low beam wants fifty or more, so the energy, range and dip were retuned
the first tail glow (1.6 energy) pooled a strong red on the road; halved

first CI run: the macOS camera test reached 0.85 of its 0.9 rear-view blend bound inside the settle window with two shadowed beams on the software renderer (run 33907041405); beams cast no shadow under the graybox-assets flag now, no bound moved
